fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pickup truck (2015 Ford F-150) in the cars by owner section.
findings: Light dust and road film along the lower doors and rocker area on both sides
Paint looks somewhat flat rather than deep gloss on the side profiles under overcast light
Dirt and debris on the driver's front floor mat and carpet
Light lint and dust on the rear carpet behind the front seats
Dust on the driver's door sill and lower trim
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-150 and it looks like a well kept truck. The driver's floor mat and carpet have some dirt on them, and the lower doors are carrying a bit of road film. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a light buff to bring up the gloss on the grey paint, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
